sections.domain: Rules of the road: second part
sections.heading: Rules of the road: second part — C
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec04-F01 | anchor: A27
Work-zone signs generally use an orange background. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F02 | anchor: A27
Near a construction area, stay alert, slow down, obey the signs and watch for workers and equipment. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F03 | anchor: A27
Obey instructions from a person directing work-zone traffic with a sign or flag. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F04 | anchor: A27
Drums, cones and other barriers keep drivers away from closed roads and areas that are dangerous to enter. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F05 | anchor: A27
Approaching or traveling through a work zone requires readiness for an unexpected stop. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F06 | anchor: A27
Yield to roadway workers or equipment and keep a cushion of space around them. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F07 | anchor: A27
Keep a clear gap behind the vehicle ahead in a work zone instead of following too closely. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F08 | anchor: A27
Speeding in a work zone can result in doubled fines and jail time. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F09 | anchor: A27
Guide signs may be square or rectangular and may use green, brown or blue backgrounds. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F10 | anchor: A27
Guide signs identify points of interest, highway services, intersecting roads and directions to cities or towns. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F11 | anchor: A27
Guide signs can direct travelers to hospitals, fuel or service stations, restaurants and hotels. [A27]
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-F12 | anchor: A28
The shape and color of a route-number sign identify its roadway category, such as an interstate, national, state, city, county or local road. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-F13 | anchor: A28
Road markings may take the form of painted lines, arrows, words or symbols. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-F14 | anchor: A28
Pavement markings divide lanes and identify passing permissions, turn lanes, pedestrian paths and stopping points for signs or signals. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-F15 | anchor: A29
White lane lines separate vehicles moving in the same direction and may be solid or dashed. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-F16 | anchor: A29
A solid yellow line separates traffic moving in opposite directions. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0029]

sections.domain: Rules of the road: second part
sections.heading: Rules of the road: second part — C2
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A29
Do not cross left of double solid yellow centerlines except to turn left or pass a slow-moving vehicle, such as a bicycle or a vehicle showing a slow-moving-vehicle sign. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A30
Beside a solid-and-dashed yellow centerline pair, drivers on the dashed-line side may pass other vehicles. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A30
Beside a solid-and-dashed yellow centerline pair, drivers on the solid-line side may not pass other vehicles. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A30
With a dashed yellow centerline, drivers in either direction may pass vehicles going their way when the maneuver is safe. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A30
A shared two-way left-turn lane has solid and dashed yellow borders on both sides and white arrows indicating left turns from either direction. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A30
Traffic from either direction may enter the shared center lane immediately before turning left, but must not use it for through travel or passing. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A30
A crosswalk identifies the part of the roadway intended for pedestrian crossing. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A30
Yield to pedestrians who are entering a crosswalk or already crossing within it. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A30
Obey a stop line placed before a crosswalk. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A30
Crosswalk markings do not all have the same appearance. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0030]

Confusables: white lines separate traffic moving alike; yellow lines separate opposing traffic. A shared center turn lane permits an imminent left turn, not through travel or passing. Mnemonic: color, pattern, purpose. Glossary: a guide sign provides route or service information; pavement markings communicate lane and movement guidance. These labels summarize cited facts without adding permissions.
